packageRules.description: Limit this trial to the GPUI family.
Group GPUI family updates for manual compatibility review.
prBodyNotes: The GPUI family has local patches for hot reload and the AccessKit window-close fix. See `vendor/README.md` and `scripts/refresh-ui-vendor.py`. Update the pinned source versions and checksums, regenerate the vendored sources, and preserve patches still missing upstream. A manifest bump alone is not a complete upgrade; check for Cargo patch or lockfile errors.
Before merging, run the workspace tests and lint checks, verify native Settings window close/reopen on macOS, and smoke-test `./dev`. Automerging is disabled.
